مُعَجِّلٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- Also One who brings to his family the إِعْجَالَة (S, O) or عُجَالَة [q. v.]; (K;) as also ↓ مُتَعَجِّلٌ : (S, O, K:) or one who brings the إِعْجَالَة from the camels pasturing at a distance from their owners. (TA.) ―
-b3- And The pastor who milks the camels once while they are in the pasture. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
